correctness.rationale: Gaussian Fourier representation proves strict PD for each h>0. The Markov matrices are uniform-reversible rank-one spectral perturbations with eigenvalues 1,1/2,0 and Dobrushin coefficient 1/2. A two-dimensional Gram quotient has exact attained maximum ab/[4(ab-c²)], with a=1-t, b=1-t/3-2t^4/3, c=(t-t^4)/sqrt(3). Its rational R(t) has strictly positive factored derivative, unique level R=3/4, and determinant expansions giving Gamma~sqrt(3/(32h)). Reflection diagonalizes the comparison kernel in its active modes, proving constant gain 1/2. All maximizers correspond to small positive probability perturbations. The script passed 1105 finite exact/numeric checks; infinite claims are proved symbolically rather than extrapolated.

The kernel-relaxation paper recognizes spectral versus kernel geometry but does not give the exact finite-state result; Demmel supplies general matrix-conditioning background but not this kernel-parametric theorem. This is best-knowledge originality, not a uniqueness certificate.
